rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|ARGS_NAMES|REQUEST_COOKIES|REQUEST_COOKIES_NAMES|REQUEST_HEADERS "@rx (?i)(?:%25){2,}|(?:%[0-9a-f]{2}){6,}|(?:&#(?:x[0-9a-f]+|[0-9]+);){2,}" "id:910001,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,auditlog,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:lowercase,msg:'Anomalous multi-layer encoding or entity obfuscation consistent with injection bypass attempts',tag:'attack-sqli',tag:'paranoia-level/2',severity:'ERROR'"
instructions: Deploy in ModSecurity include or main config. Targets multi-layer URL encoding and HTML entity chaining used to bypass WAF normalization. Removed duplicate t:urlDecodeUni transformation. Fixed percent-encoding pattern from %(?:25){2,} to (?:%25){2,} for correct double-encoding detection.

Deploy in phase 2 after body parsing. Detects classic boolean-based SQLi patterns like OR 1=1, AND 'a'='a' after comment stripping and whitespace normalization. Removed inline comment bypass pattern since replaceComments transformation handles it. Removed duplicate t:urlDecodeUni.

rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|REQUEST_COOKIES|REQUEST_HEADERS "@rx (?i)(?:^|[^a-z0-9_'\"])\s*union\b\s*(?:all\s+)?select\b" "id:910003,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,auditlog,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:replaceComments,t:compressWhitespace,t:lowercase,msg:'SQLi UNION SELECT sequence detected after normalization',tag:'attack-sqli',tag:'paranoia-level/1',severity:'CRITICAL'"
instructions: Deploy in phase 2. Detects UNION SELECT patterns including UNION ALL SELECT after normalization. Broadened from quote-prefixed-only to general UNION SELECT detection, covering more bypass variants. Removed duplicate t:urlDecodeUni. Rule 910004 covers specific UNION enumeration and is kept separate.

rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|REQUEST_COOKIES|REQUEST_HEADERS "@rx (?i)\bunion\b\s*(?:all\s+)?select\b\s*\d+\s*,\s*(?:user\s*\(\s*\)|@@version|version\s*\(\s*\)|database\s*\(\s*\)|schema\s*\(\s*\)|\d+)" "id:910004,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,auditlog,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:replaceComments,t:compressWhitespace,t:lowercase,msg:'SQLi UNION enumeration and data extraction pattern detected',tag:'attack-sqli',tag:'paranoia-level/1',severity:'CRITICAL'"
instructions: Deploy in phase 2. Targets UNION-based enumeration payloads that extract user, version, database metadata. Complements 910003 with more specific data extraction signatures. Removed duplicate t:urlDecodeUni.

rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|REQUEST_COOKIES|REQUEST_HEADERS "@rx (?i)(?:^|[^a-z0-9_'])(?:'|\")?\s*(?:and|or)\s*\(\s*select\s+\d+\s+from\s+\(\s*select\s*\(\s*(?:sleep|benchmark)\s*\(" "id:910005,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,auditlog,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:replaceComments,t:compressWhitespace,t:lowercase,msg:'Time-based SQLi subselect with sleep or benchmark detected',tag:'attack-sqli',tag:'paranoia-level/1',severity:'CRITICAL'"
instructions: Deploy in phase 2. Targets time-based blind SQLi using nested SELECT with sleep() or benchmark() functions. Removed duplicate t:urlDecodeUni. Extended quote matching to include double-quote variants.

rule: SecRule REQUEST_URI|ARGS|REQUEST_COOKIES|REQUEST_HEADERS "@rx (?i)(?:\badmin\b|\bid\s*=\s*admin\b).{0,32}(?:and|or)\b\s*1\s*=\s*1" "id:910007,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,auditlog,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:replaceComments,t:compressWhitespace,t:lowercase,msg:'Credential or identifier parameter tampering with boolean SQLi detected',tag:'attack-sqli',tag:'paranoia-level/2',severity:'CRITICAL'"
instructions: Deploy in phase 2. Targets credential-stuffing boolean injection patterns specifically combining admin identifiers with 1=1 tautologies. Removed duplicate t:urlDecodeUni. Kept as paranoia level 2 due to potential FP risk on admin-related pages.
